title: Most news feeds are broken because they are designed to keep you scrolling, not to keep you informed.
body:
We have all been there. You open an app expecting to catch up on the world, and thirty minutes later you are stuck in a cycle of rage-bait and irrelevant noise. It is exhausting. The problem is that current algorithms prioritize engagement above all else. They show you what you are likely to click on, which is rarely what you actually need to know.

True personalization should be the opposite of that. It should be about respecting your time. It means filtering out the clutter so you can focus on the stories that matter to your life, your career, and your interests. When news is curated with intent, you stop feeling overwhelmed and start feeling prepared.

AI has the potential to act as a personal editor rather than a click-driven machine. It can cut through the noise, summarize key points, and deliver a clean briefing that fits into your schedule. We believe the future of news is not about more content, but about better, more relevant content.
cta: We are building exactly that at HEADLINNE.com if you want to see how it works.
